setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=new RegExp("N[\u00e3a]o foi poss[i\u00ed]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[i\u00ed]vel|Algo deu errado|Something went wrong|Falha ao|Pop-up bloqueado|Popup bloqueado|Sem permiss[\u00e3a]o",'i');const ign=new RegExp("$^",'i');const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&!ign.test(m[0])&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Compra", "Venda", "Transferência", "Edição Manual", "Exclusão", "Produção", "Saldo inicial"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]")].filter(e=>!false||e.innerText.includes(""));const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()
